eligibility_rule: A claim may be paid only when the current ticket history contains a hazard incident reference, an evacuation notice, an itemized lodging invoice, a completed approval reference, an exact approved amount, and a recipient whose name, user ID, and bank-card ending match the current Bank System record.
decision_rules: Apply the same evidence requirements to every claim.
A requested amount is not an approved amount.
If any required evidence or recipient field is absent or inconsistent, do not transfer funds and record the specific missing items.
For an eligible claim, transfer the exact approved amount once and include the claim ID in the transfer description.
After a transfer, verify the returned transaction ID, final payer balance, and transfer history before recording completion.
Ticket audit notes must be internal and may include only the last four digits of a bank card.
